title: Test case covers serialization
detail: The test case now includes serialization tests for the specific scenario where `max_digits` and `decimal_places` are equal.

title: Potential index out of bounds
detail: If `index` is at the last character of the string, `index <= (codepoint_count - 1)` will be false, and `index` will be incremented by 1. This could lead to an index out of bounds error if the next character is not a valid grapheme.
note: flags the comparison but says <= is false on the last character; it's true, which is the bug
